I never felt like just an intern, and I was excited to get to go in and work."

## What Is an Alfa Insurance Internship?


An Alfa Insurance internship is a paid, 6–12 week program that places college students into real department roles at a regional property-and-casualty carrier affiliated with the[Alabama Farmers Federation](https://www.alfainsurance.com/about-alfa) , founded in 1946. The company writes auto, home, life, farm, business, and health insurance across Alabama, Georgia, and Mississippi, employs roughly 2,500 people, and holds an[A (Excellent) rating from A.M. Best](https://www.alfainsurance.com/about-alfa) . Interns work across 10+ departments including Actuary, Investments, Claims, Marketing, IT, Risk Management, Data Management, HR, Business Innovation, and Underwriting. The program includes weekly **Midweek Mixers** that walk the intern class through every department, a session in Alfa's **leadership academy** , a community **Serve Project** , and[student housing options in Montgomery](https://www.alfainsurance.com/getmedia/ddb1a5bc-2508-4b10-a406-0dbc9a1670ef/Internship-Program-Overview.pdf) . Alfa's 2023 cohort of[16 named interns](https://www.alfainsurance.com/news-and-insights/2023-internship-program-a-successful-journey-comes-to-a-close) sat across eight departments, and one former intern, Evie Campbell,[converted to a full-time position after graduation](https://www.alfainsurance.com/getmedia/ddb1a5bc-2508-4b10-a406-0dbc9a1670ef/Internship-Program-Overview.pdf) . Vault ranked the program[#1 Best Internship for Women](https://www.alfainsurance.com/news-and-insights/alfa-insurance-internship-program-top-ranked-by-vault) and #2 in Insurance in its 2026 rankings.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


Alfa Insurance casts a wider eligibility net than most insurance internship programs. The requirements below come from the employer-hosted Vault report and the Internship Program Overview PDF:


• **Academic level:** college sophomores, juniors, seniors, recent college graduates, graduate students, business school students, and law school students. This is unusually broad; most insurance intern programs cap at rising seniors.


• **Majors:** Accounting, Actuarial Science, Agriculture, Analytics, Animal Science/Farming, Asset and Investment Management, Communications, Computer Science, Insurance, Legal/Compliance, Market Research, Marketing, Politics/Public Policy/Activism, Public Relations, Risk Management.


• **GPA:** not published. No GPA requirement appears on the careers page, in the Internship Program Overview PDF, or in the Vault report. Do not assume a threshold.


• **Work authorization:** not published. No live intern requisition exists to carry a standard EEO/work-authorization block. Contact Alfa's recruiting team directly.


### Does Alfa Insurance Have a GPA Cutoff?


No published cutoff exists. Alfa does not list a minimum GPA on its careers page, in its internship PDFs, or in the Vault firm-info record for the program. The company's interview process is conversational and personality-driven: interns report being asked questions like "How would your best friend describe you?" and "Tell me about some relevant leadership experience." This suggests Alfa weights cultural fit and demonstrated interest over raw academic metrics. If your GPA is below 3.0 but you have actuarial exam progress, a policy research project, or leadership experience that connects to Alfa's Faith, Family, Community, and Integrity values, that evidence speaks louder than a number.

## What Is the Alfa Insurance Application and Interview Process Like?


Alfa's interview process is unusually short and conversational compared to large national carriers. Based on intern accounts in the employer-hosted Vault report:


1. **Register at[alfa-internship.careerplug.com/account](https://alfa-internship.careerplug.com/account) .** This is the dedicated internship board, separate from Alfa's corporate, agent, and sales-rep boards. A corporate-board profile does not put you in the intern pipeline.


2. **Apply when a requisition appears.** As of September 2026, no posting is live. Check the board weekly.


3. **One interview, usually with the department head.** Interns describe a single, conversational interview, sometimes as a relaxed four-person panel. One intern said: "Very straightforward interview process. I knew at the end of the interview whether I had the position or not."


4. **Expect personality and values questions, not case studies.** Reported questions include "How would your best friend describe you?", "Why did you apply to Alfa?", "What do you like to do outside of school?", and "Tell me about some relevant leadership experience you have."


5. **Receive an answer quickly.** Interns report learning the outcome at the end of the interview or shortly after.


Because Alfa's process is one round and conversational, preparation is about being a person with a genuine answer to "why Alfa," not about drilling 50 behavioral questions. Know the company's 80-year history, its Alabama Farmers Federation roots, its Faith/Family/Community/Integrity values, and have a specific department in mind. Our[HireVue question guide with a free AI mock tool](https://www.extern.com/post/hirevue-interview-questions-2025-free-ai-mock-tool) covers the behavioral-question format, though Alfa's process is warmer and less structured than a typical HireVue.

## How Do You Stand Out at a Regional Carrier Where Nobody Publishes a Deadline?


Three moves, all executable right now. First, register on the dedicated internship board at alfa-internship.careerplug.com/account today, because there is no published date and the board is the only place the requisition will appear. A standing profile means you apply the day it flips. Second, have a real answer to "why Alfa." The company is 80 years old, member-founded by the Alabama Farmers Federation, writes in three states, and is built on Faith, Family, Community, and Integrity. A generic "I want insurance experience" answer will not land in a one-round conversational interview where you learn the outcome at the end. Third, name the department you want and say why. Ten-plus departments host interns, from Actuary and Investments to Claims, Marketing, IT, and the Federation public-policy track. The Federation track is Alfa's true differentiator: if public policy, agriculture, or government relations interests you, Alfa's affiliation with the Alabama Farmers Federation offers a policy internship inside an insurance company, a combination essentially unavailable at national carriers. And ask about housing early. "Student Housing Options Available in Montgomery" is a named benefit with no published detail; it is a legitimate and useful question for a recruiter that also signals serious intent.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 Alfa Insurance internship?


No. The summer 2026 program has concluded. Alfa's 2023 cohort recap was published in early August, and the program typically wraps by then. The next opportunity is summer 2027, but Alfa does not publish an application open date or deadline. Register on the dedicated internship board at alfa-internship.careerplug.com/account now so you are ready when 2027 postings appear.


### Is the Alfa Insurance internship paid?


Yes. "Paid Internship" is the first benefit listed on Alfa's own Internship Program Overview, and Vault's compensation field for the program reads "Paid." However, Alfa does not publish an hourly rate, and no salary aggregator carries one either. Indeed's Alfa intern salary page exists but contains no figures.


### How long is an Alfa Insurance internship?


Six to twelve weeks, per Vault's firm-info record for the program. The summer program runs through early August. Interns report working straight 40-hour weeks Monday through Friday with no holiday work and time off granted when asked.


### Where are Alfa Insurance internships located?


The documented intern locations are Montgomery, Birmingham, Huntsville, and Mobile, Alabama. The Montgomery home office is the center of the program, with the on-site cafeteria, fitness center, and Midweek Mixers. Alfa also offers student housing options in Montgomery for interns who need to relocate.


### Which departments hire Alfa Insurance interns?


Marketing, Underwriting, Information Technology, Actuary, Investments, Human Resources, Business Innovation, Risk Management, Data Management, Claims, and more. Vault's broader list adds Accounting, Agriculture, Analytics, Communications, Computer Science, Legal/Compliance, and Politics/Public Policy. Alfa's 2023 cohort of 16 interns sat across eight departments.


### What is the Alfa Insurance internship interview like?


Interns describe a single, conversational interview with the department head, sometimes as a relaxed four-person panel. One intern said they knew the outcome at the end of the meeting. Reported questions include "How would your best friend describe you?", "Why did you apply to Alfa?", and "Tell me about some relevant leadership experience you have."


### Does Alfa Insurance require a minimum GPA for internships?


No published GPA requirement exists. Alfa does not list a minimum GPA on its careers page, in its Internship Program Overview PDF, or in the Vault report. The interview process is conversational and personality-driven, suggesting Alfa weights cultural fit and demonstrated interest over raw academic metrics.


### Do Alfa Insurance interns get full-time offers?


Alfa publishes no conversion rate. Vault ranked the program #47 (tied) for Employment Prospects in 2026, solid but well below its #1 and #2 headline ranks. Alfa's own recap says it keeps intern resumes on record, and its program PDF features Evie Campbell, a named former intern who converted to a full-time role after graduation.


Alfa's internship board is empty today, and the company publishes no deadline.
